versions.changelog:
obsidian-charts-layout 1.0.0

- Initial release of the skill for the Obsidian Charts View plugin (caronchen/obsidian-chartsview-plugin).
- Provides setup guidance, G2Plot-compatible chart syntax, and troubleshooting tips.
- Covers correct data formats, field mapping, and always-visible annotation labels.
- Includes bilingual (CN/EN) Markdown layout rules for creating AI daily reports and exporting to PDF.
- Contains detailed field references, formatter examples, and ready-to-use chart templates (Pie, Bar, Column, etc.).
- Emphasizes critical do’s and don’ts for seamless integration in Obsidian.
